# Neverball for Quest

Neverball and Neverputt played in a Meta Quest headset, with the player's hands as the controls.

## Language

### Games

**Neverball**:
The game where the player tilts the level to roll a ball through an obstacle course against the clock.
_Avoid_: ball mode

**Neverputt**:
The mini-golf game where the player hits a ball into a hole in as few strokes as possible.
_Avoid_: putt mode, golf

### Viewpoint and movement

**Life-size**:
The viewpoint where the player stands inside the course at real scale, in both games.
_Avoid_: immersive, room-scale, first-person

**World scale**:
The real-world size of the ball, which fixes the size of everything else: a golf ball in **Neverputt**, a bowling ball in **Neverball**.
_Avoid_: zoom, scale factor

**Course height**:
The height of the course's ground relative to the real floor, set by the player: above it for seated play, below it to look down on the course from higher up.
_Avoid_: floor offset, seated mode

**Chase view**:
The flat-screen camera that follows the ball, which this port replaces.
_Avoid_: HMD mode, VR mode

**Blink-follow**:
A brief fade that puts the player beside the ball in **Neverputt** when it stops.
_Avoid_: teleport, snap, follow cam

### Hands and interface

**Play hand**:
The hand that holds the **Putter** or does **Hand tilt**.
_Avoid_: main hand, right hand

**Off-hand**:
The hand that is not the **Play hand**; it wears the **Wrist HUD** and points at the **Menu panel**.
_Avoid_: left hand, secondary hand

**Menu panel**:
The floating panel in the world where the game's menus appear.
_Avoid_: overlay, screen

**Wrist HUD**:
The game status (time, coins, balls, strokes, score) shown on the **Off-hand** wrist during play.
_Avoid_: overlay, head-up display

**Hand-off**:
The pause between **Neverputt** turns when the headset passes to the next player.
_Avoid_: turn change, swap

### Neverball play

**Tilt**:
The rotation of the level floor that makes the ball roll.
_Avoid_: steer, lean

**Hand tilt**:
The controller, held like a tray, whose tip matches the **Tilt** of the floor: level controller, level floor; directions are measured from where the controller points.
_Avoid_: motion control, gyro

### Neverputt play

**Stroke**:
One hit of the ball, defined by its **Aim** and **Strength**.
_Avoid_: shot, putt, hit

**Aim**:
The horizontal direction a **Stroke** sends the ball.
_Avoid_: rotation, angle

**Strength**:
How hard a **Stroke** sends the ball.
_Avoid_: power, magnitude, mag

**Putter**:
The virtual club held by the controller, whose head strikes the ball.
_Avoid_: club, stick

**Live**:
The state of the **Putter** while the trigger is held, when its head is solid and contact with the ball is a **Stroke**.
_Avoid_: armed, active, solid

**Swing**:
The motion of the **Putter**; it becomes a **Stroke** only when a **Live** head hits a stopped ball.
_Avoid_: flick, gesture

## Relationships

- A **Swing** produces at most one **Stroke**, and only when a **Live** **Putter** hits a stopped ball
- A **Putter** that is not **Live** passes through the ball, so practice **Swings** never count
- A **Stroke** has exactly one **Aim** and one **Strength**
- **Strength** is the **Putter** head's speed at contact, up to a cap; **Aim** is its direction of travel
- **Hand tilt** drives **Tilt**; **Neverball** has no **Strength**
- In **Life-size** **Neverball**, **Tilt** visibly rotates the level about the player, who stays upright on a floor that does not move under them
- **Blink-follow** is the only way the game moves the player; in **Neverball** the player stands still for the whole level
- Each **Neverputt** player has their own **Course height** and **Play hand**, applied at their **Hand-off**

## Example dialogue

> **Dev:** "Does a harder **Swing** in **Neverball** make the ball go faster?"
> **Domain expert:** "No. **Neverball** has no **Strength**. Only **Hand tilt** matters there. **Strength** comes only from a **Swing** in **Neverputt**."
> **Dev:** "If I take a practice **Swing** right next to the ball, is that a **Stroke**?"
> **Domain expert:** "Only if the **Putter** is **Live**. Without the trigger held it passes through the ball. And after the ball stops, **Blink-follow** puts you beside it for the next one."

## Flagged ambiguities

- "power" meant **Strength** in **Neverputt**. Resolved: **Neverball** has no power; its only input is **Tilt**.
- "immersive" could mean a **Chase view** in a headset, a tabletop model, or standing in the course. Resolved: **Life-size** for both games.
